fields.name: Model
fields.evidence: Vertex stage of program 621 (a rigid shape with no skeleton block): rows 0 to 2 of the block's first three vectors multiply the model-space position into the shape's frame, as the bone rows do for a skinned shape.

fields.name: Position
fields.evidence: Vertex slot 4 of program 6183: its xyz is viewed with the context view rows and added to the view-space vertex, so it is the instance position in world space.

fields.name: HeightFadeBottom
fields.evidence: Fragment slot 10, .y only, program 6183: subtracted from the height term and from slot 11 to form the divisor of a clamped vertical gradient.

fields.name: HeightFadeTop
fields.evidence: Fragment slot 11, .y only: the top of the gradient, so (height - bottom) / (top - bottom).

fields.name: HeightFadeOffset
fields.evidence: Fragment slot 12, .y only: added to the height term before the gradient.

fields.name: HeightFadeBase
fields.evidence: Fragment slot 13, .y only: subtracted from the fragment's view-space y before the gradient.

fields.name: LightIndex
fields.evidence: Fragment slot 14, .x only: two 16-bit halves multiplied by 144 and used as indices into a table of lights; zero selects the first entry.
